**Reproduced documentation/authority mismatch.** The generator `SUMMARY` says the four inside-corner markers are repainted with `rect_color`, “restoring the solid rect.” The canonical Racket rule and canonical outputs instead clear those four cells to background `0`.

I generated a lawful 10×10 input with seed `20261003`, sample index `0`, and exact rectangle/color overrides. The target's own `self_check` returned no errors. Supported Racket execution then produced `0` at all four former inside-marker cells. A rival implementing the written SUMMARY produces rectangle color `5` at those same four cells. All outside-corner placements agree, isolating the mismatch to exactly four cells.
